segments.sn14.21:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātusova, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.21:1.7: āraddhavīriyā āraddhavīriyehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti … pe ….(1)
segments.sn14.21:2.5: upaṭṭhitassatino upaṭṭhitassatīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti … pe ….
